title: WA Recovery Pro v1.8.0 — Multi-Select, Batch Delete & Multi-Item Sharing
changelog: ☑️ Multi-Select Action Bar: Long-press or tap select icon to select multiple chats, messages, media, or voice notes
🗑️ Batch & 1-Tap Deletion: Delete individual messages, whole conversations, or batch selected media with confirmation
📤 Multi-Item & Native Sharing: Share selected messages, photos, videos, or voice notes directly to WhatsApp
📸 Real MediaProjection Engine: Pixel-perfect screen capture & full MP4 video recording
🛡️ Strict Real-Time Guard: 100% blocks old device media from importing
